paragraphs.text: We tune adsorbent synthesis with particle swarm optimization (PSO) and characterise samples by X-ray diffraction (XRD). Graphene Oxide sheets were purchased.
Composite C1 was prepared from graphene oxide and chitosan. Equilibrium data followed the Langmuir isotherm. J. Smith performed the measurements.
Composite C1 reached 120 mg/g for methylene blue at 25 °C. Reduced graphene oxide was not tested.
